context: In Theorem 3.16, we have also shown that it is not possible to test whether a given automaton semigroup (or monoid) is equidivisible. By Levi’s lemma (Fact 2.2) this is one part of a semigroup (monoid) being free while the other one is the existence of a (proper) length function. So, the following question naturally arises. ▶ Open Problem 4.2. Is the following problem decidable? Input: a (complete) S-automaton 𝒯 Question: does S (𝒯 ) (M (𝒯 )) admit a (proper) length function?
